# ezghcloud_database_backup (Data Source)

Read an existing EZGH Cloud database_backup by its ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Canonical prefixed ID.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was taken.
- `database_id` (String) Database (dbi_) to back up. Changing it takes a new backup.
- `engine` (String) Engine of the database it was taken of.
- `engine_version` (String) Engine version it was taken at.
- `expires_at` (String) When it expires; null for a manual backup kept until deleted.
- `kind` (String) manual.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `size_bytes` (String) Size as an exact decimal byte count.
- `status` (String) What the backup is doing.
